binary_minimum_gate.method: Exact determinant bounds exhaust every coefficient pair capable of norm below the host/S3 minimum; rank-one forms use gcd(u^2,v^2,u.v).

first_cutting_wall.same_height_acuteness: For distinct q=2 roots, g in O with 0<g<=2 and |g'|<=2 gives g in {1,sqrt(2),2}; g=1 or sqrt(2) would make the coefficient-vector difference have rational trace part 2 or 4 below min(L)=8, and g=2 is equality.

scope: Complete controls and exact necessary Gram chronology through the first accepted cutter H=362+256*sqrt(2), followed by a strict same-direction replacement. Not Vinberg termination.
